metadata.title: Sign in | Saling Jaga
metadata.description: Sign in to the Saling Jaga health management portal

auth.visualDescription: One record per visit, from registration, encounter, and pharmacy through billing, with BPJS and SATUSEHAT reporting handled in the background.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your staff account to access the portal.
auth.authorizedOnly: Authorized personnel only. Contact your administrator for access.

validation.password: Password must contain at least 8 characters.

errors.loginFailed: Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.

challenge.title: Two-factor verification
challenge.subtitle: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor verification.

errors.rejected: That code was not accepted. Codes can only be used once — wait for a new one and try again.
errors.expired: This sign-in attempt timed out. Please enter your password again.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.failed: Unable to verify right now. Please try again.

enrolment.title: Set up two-factor verification
enrolment.subtitle: Your account can view or export patient data, so it needs a second factor. Scan this with an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
enrolment.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor verification
enrolment.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key into your authenticator app instead:

errors.rejected: That code was not accepted. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try the next code.
errors.expired: This sign-in attempt timed out. Please enter your password again.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.failed: Unable to set up two-factor verification right now. Please try again.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: Each code signs you in once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.warning: This is the only time these are shown. Store them somewhere safe and offline — we keep only a one-way hash, so nobody can look them up for you.

invite.metadataDescription: Set a password for your Saling Jaga staff account
invite.title: Set your password
invite.subtitle: You were invited to join Saling Jaga as {email}.
invite.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
invite.acceptError: We could not complete your invitation. Please try again.
invite.invalidLink: This invitation link is not valid.
invite.alreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used. Try signing in instead.
invite.noLongerValid: This invitation has expired or was withdrawn.
invite.invalidHelp: Ask your administrator to send a new invitation.
invite.successBody: Sign in as {email} with the password you just chose.
invite.footerNote: Nobody at the clinic can see the password you choose here.

search.label: Search
search.title: Global search
search.description: Search across patients, doctors, users, and pages.

routes.dashboardSubtitle: Key metrics and activity across {facilityName} today.
routes.patientsSubtitle: Manage and monitor current and past patient records across all departments.
routes.doctorsSubtitle: Manage doctor profiles, specialties, and weekly schedules.
routes.appointmentsSubtitle: Coordinate visits across doctors and time slots.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.description: You will be signed out in {seconds} seconds to protect patient data on this workstation.

deliveryLink.metadataDescription: Download a document the clinic sent you
deliveryLink.title: Your document from the clinic
deliveryLink.ready: Your document is ready to download. This download link is valid for a few minutes; reopen the link from your message if it has expired.
deliveryLink.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
deliveryLink.invalidLink: The link may have expired, been withdrawn by the clinic, or the document may no longer be available.
deliveryLink.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
deliveryLink.invalidHelp: Contact the clinic to have the document sent again.
deliveryLink.footerNote: Nothing about you is shown on this page; the document itself is only served to whoever holds the link the clinic sent.
